title: Critical bond and site percolation on the cubic lattice
summary: We prove that nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond and site percolation on ℤ 3 have no infinite cluster at their respective critical parameters. The proof combines a finite connection inequality for independent hyperedges with a finite-scale extension estimate and an adaptive exploration.
family_title: Critical percolation on every quasi-transitive graph

review.reason: Proves critical bond and site percolation on the cubic lattice have no infinite cluster.
